resolution.width_angstrom: center/115000; nominal template scale only, not an estimated or fitted line width
resolution.production_fwhm: retain separately as historical fixed-template width; do not interpret as measured

grouping.core_window_overlap_edge: abs(lambda_a-lambda_b)<=0.5 Angstrom (two ±0.25 Angstrom core windows touch/overlap)
grouping.construction: Undirected connected components. Stable group IDs by target then minimum wavelength then minimum candidate_id. Retain every pair edge and flag components whose endpoint span exceeds the respective local single-edge scale. Groups are bookkeeping and potential dependence, never counts of independent physical sources.
grouping.scope: Barycentric air wavelengths, no stellar radial-velocity correction; no between-target physical line matching. All selected events retained including singletons.

metrics.join: Exact candidate_id with dp_id, target and production input hash agreement
metrics.epoch_summary: Carry original continuous barycentric/topocentric correlations and amplitudes; no thresholds to classify repeats or origin
metrics.fixed_templates: Import discovery narrow and broad3 RMS from completed ALL_EPOCH_MEASUREMENTS, report broad3/narrow RMS ratio if denominator positive; neither this ratio nor either fixed-template width estimates intrinsic FWHM
metrics.sample_coverage: Count each selected source exposure once; retain original number of other epochs and distinct exposure counts per group. Do not add observing time or count repeated event/epoch rows as independent observations.
metrics.low_continuum: Preserve existing per-profile flags for discovery and other epochs in each frame; report exact affected IDs
metrics.berv: Preserve existing <1 nominal-resolution-element flag; above1 does not prove distinguishable origins

work_queues.stable_order: Original selected candidate order, not significance/strength rank; every event in exactly one primary routing category plus orthogonal flags
routing_order: NORMALIZATION_CONTEXT if any existing comparison/discovery low-continuum flag
FRAME_BASELINE_CONTEXT if existing BERV span <1 resolution element
JOINT_PROFILE_CONTEXT if its core-overlap component has >1 member
work_queues.limitations: Routing chooses next evidence type, not likelihood or a scientific classifier. Queue order does not replace project priority: pending raw data then mapping limitations first.
next_evidence: Normalization context: examine unnormalized native order flux, local background and continuum in both overlapping orders; do not trust ratios with faint continuum.
Frame baseline context: broaden same-target archival baseline after frozen selection, retain physical stellar RV uncertainty.

Joint profile context: compare the complete neighboring absorption/emission pattern and all raw-order panels for the group; quantify free-width models with calibration and uncertainties only in a separately frozen analysis.
Individual profile context: inspect all raw covering orders and broader stellar/template context; seek independent exposure/instrument or sky/calibration control before origin claims.

limits: Post-detection cohort; shared data and nearby windows induce dependence.
Metrics are descriptive; no false-alarm probability, sensitivity, flux, EIRP or calibrated null result.
No new laser candidate or physical-origin label follows from grouping, correlation, frame agreement or template RMS.
Prior source outputs were available and a few metadata/examples were inspected before this method; this is not blind preregistration.
